messages:
Olga: Heads-up — legal surfaced a customer requirement: 7-year immutable audit retention + formal evidence export API. Need product/infra alignment ASAP.
Kevin: 7 years is large for hosted. Is customer asking for raw inputs or hashed artifacts?
Olga: they requested raw audit trails: auth events, admin actions, model input blobs + timestamps. PII may be redacted but legal prefers raw for eDiscovery.
Sam: redaction vs eDiscovery is tricky. If raw inputs required, we should gate on BYOK/escrow and contractual terms.
Maya: auditors want tamper-evident manifests and chain-of-custody. We should spec an "evidence export" artifact format (signed manifests + digests).
Jordan: propose minimal launch criteria: 1) Export API v1 (signed S3 manifest), 2) Tenant retention TTL UI, 3) BYOK handshake for export keys, 4) Legal signoff and hosted SLA addendum.
Olga: timeline: legal asked for a Q3 pilot for a Fortune customer. Can we make that?
Sam: rough infra estimate: ~8w export infra + 4w KMS integration + 2w compliance review. Q3 pilot doable if prioritized.
Kevin: also need Economics: 7-year retention implies large cold store + index for search. Recommend offering cold tier (Glacier-style) with lightweight index.
Maya: privacy question: do we allow raw-input retention by default in hosted? I'd recommend opt-in with contract and DPA appendix.
Olga: agreed. Default for hosted: hashed inputs + metadata. Raw inputs allowed only behind contract + BYOK.
legal-bot: @Olga created ticket FIN-452: "Evidence export SLA playbook" — https://tickets/FIN-452
Jordan: rollout plan: enable on Dedicated tenant for pilot customer first, then opt-in for hosted tenants. Canary to single-customer.
Sam: infra note: 7-year search model -> keep minimal searchable index (event ids + timestamps) and store payloads as blobs in cold S3 with periodic manifests to enable validation.
Kevin: cost sketch: assume 500GB/month * 84 months ≈ 42TB. Glacier Deep Archive cost estimate to be attached to FIN-452 for sales.
Maya: add SOC2/evidence checklist: region retention matrix, signed manifests, chain-of-custody docs, KMS audit logs, legal-hold APIs.
Olga: action: form working group (Olga, Kevin, Sam, Maya, Jordan). Deliver proposal + cost model + launch criteria in 2 weeks.
Sam: I'll draft infra spec + export schema. Quick example payload for export request:
```
POST /v1/exports
{
  "customer_id": "cust-123",
  "start": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "end": "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z",
  "types": ["auth", "admin", "model_inputs"],
  "kms": {
    "byok": true,
    "key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd"
  },
  "delivery": {
    "s3_bucket": "s3://customer-exports/cust-123/",
    "signed_manifest": true
  }
}
```
Kevin: include APIs for tenant TTL config and legal-hold markers.
Maya: don't forget region residency for EU customers + export handling per region.
Olga: can someone sync with sales/legal before Monday? Customer call is scheduled.
Maya: I'll join the call Monday 10am PT.
Sam: adding launch checklist item: "legal signoff on BYOK export terms".
Jordan: noted and linked to FIN-452.
Olga: thanks team — meeting invite sent. We'll reconvene after the pilot scoping call.
